metadata.name: AWS DevOps Agent
metadata.description: Official remote MCP server for AWS DevOps Agent, giving AI agents access to an Agent Space to investigate incidents, review architecture, optimize costs, and map topology.

config.notes: The URL uses us-east-1: replace it with the AWS Region of your Agent Space. DEVOPS_AGENT_TOKEN must hold an access token for that Agent Space: turn on access tokens on the Agent Space's Configuration tab in the AWS DevOps Agent console, then create one in the DevOps Agent web app under Settings > Access Tokens (scope read or operate, expiry 1 to 60 days). Set the client's request timeout to at least 120 seconds, since first responses can take 5 to 30 seconds. To sign requests with your local AWS credentials (SigV4) instead of a token, run the server through uvx mcp-proxy-for-aws@latest with --service aidevops and --region set to the same Region.

installConfigs.instructions: Replace <region> with the AWS Region of your Agent Space (for example us-east-1). Create an access token in the DevOps Agent web app under Settings > Access Tokens (access tokens must first be turned on in the Agent Space's Configuration tab), set it as the environment variable DEVOPS_AGENT_TOKEN, and approve DEVOPS_AGENT_TOKEN in Kiro under Settings > MCP Approved Env Vars. To use your AWS credentials (SigV4) instead of a token, run the server as uvx mcp-proxy-for-aws@latest https://connect.aidevops.<region>.api.aws/mcp --service aidevops --region <region>. The aws-devops-agent Kiro power sets up both.
